name: BazaarSwap
description: Meta DEX aggregator that races cross-chain routing providers (Rubic and others) to move assets from other chains into Cardano, or back, and returns the route with the best net output.
notes: Disclosure: BazaarSwap is built by Fortress Enterprises, which also maintains this taxonomy; it was listed by the same reviewed PR as every other venue and gets no ranking advantage. The routing backend is closed source; its MCP client (bazaarswap-mcp) is open. Assets are what was verified live on 2026-10-14 (10 USDC on Base quoted into 40.86 ADA via Rubic); the provider set routes more, so the list is directional. Cardano-side legs are plain payments to a provider deposit address, so the venue lists no scripts.
